description: Ethics Village focuses on technology ethics, civil liberties, regulatory oversight, government surveillance accountability, and public interest cybersecurity policy.

talks.title: Federal Communications Commission Keynote
talks.teaser: FCC Commissioner Geoffrey Starks discusses telecommunications supply chain security, network resilience, and public interest ethics.

talks.title: Privacy and Civil Liberties Oversight Board Perspectives
talks.teaser: PCLOB Board Member Travis LeBlanc analyzes government surveillance authorities, constitutional protections, and civil liberties oversight.

talks.title: Food and Drug Administration: Medical Device Cybersecurity Ethics
talks.teaser: FDA Cyber Policy Advisor Jessica Wilkerson examines regulatory frameworks, vulnerability disclosure, and patient safety ethics in medical devices.

talks.title: TechCongress: Bridging Technologists and Congressional Policy
talks.teaser: Leisel Bogan discusses TechCongress fellows embedding technical expertise into congressional committees to shape technology legislation.

talks.title: Federal Trade Commission: Consumer Protection and Tech Enforcement
talks.teaser: FTC Commissioner Rohit Chopra explores regulatory enforcement against surveillance capitalism, corporate data abuse, and algorithmic bias.
